facts.name: Luis Bustamante
facts.assignment: Levy all county court matters, juvenile delinquency, truancy, shelter hearings and grand jury selection; current general assignment order also lists mental health.

checklist.summary: Email Mandy Waters with case number, case name and relevant matter; copy all parties unless an ex parte communication is authorized by law. Follow the assistant’s out-of-office instructions.

Request and coordinate hearing time by email with opposing counsel and self-represented parties copied; file and serve notice immediately after reserving time, including ADA notice and any remote credentials. Obtain court approval through the assistant before cancelling. The guide lists certain clerk-scheduled hearing exceptions.

File motions through the clerk; notify the assistant immediately when filing an emergency motion and proposed order. No separate general conferral requirement identified in these practical sections; applicable rules and hearing orders remain separate.
Submit proposed orders in Word through the e-portal if available; without portal access, email the assistant. Submit within 30 days after hearing unless the court directs otherwise.

Hearing materials are due five days before hearing. Courtesy copies for evidentiary proceedings are due five days before; PDF/Word to assistant for fewer than 50 pages, mailed tabbed binder/folder for more than 50. Exactly 50 pages is not specified.

Zoom appearance requires a motion at least five days before hearing; e-file motion and submit proposed order through portal. If granted, order supplies Zoom information; contact assistant for credentials and follow Rule2.530 eligibility and linked Zoom guidelines.

facts.summary: County-civil scheduling through assistant Mandy Waters; Word proposed orders via e-portal and permission-based Zoom appearances. Practical procedures reviewed without expanding noncivil subjects.
